_about: Airtable base for fargotire.com. Each entry under tables is shaped for Airtable's Create Table API (POST https://api.airtable.com/v0/meta/bases/{baseId}/tables). The first field in each table is its primary field. Field descriptions are written for the shop owner, who will edit this base without help. Time-of-day values are text in the form 7:30 AM because Airtable has no time-only field.

tables.name: Business Info
tables.description: One row only. Name, address, phones and other facts the whole site uses. Change something here, then click Update website.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The business name exactly as it should appear everywhere: Fargo Tire Service. Keep it matching the Google Business Profile.

fields.name: Legal Name
fields.description: Used only in the fine print and search-engine data. Fargo Tire Service, Inc.

fields.name: Tagline
fields.description: The big line next to the tire man on the home page.

fields.name: Motto
fields.description: The smaller line under the tagline on the home page, also in the footer.

fields.name: Founded
fields.description: Year the shop opened. Shows as Since 1950.

fields.name: State
fields.description: Two letters, e.g. ND.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: Main number. Every Call button dials this.

fields.name: Public Email
fields.description: Shown on the Contact page. Leave blank to show no email.

fields.name: Form Notice Email
fields.description: Where quote requests from the website get emailed. Not shown on the site.

fields.name: Google Review Link
fields.description: From Google Business Profile: Ask for reviews, then copy the link (it looks like https://g.page/r/.../review). While this is filled, the site shows a Leave a Google review button on the home page and in the footer.

fields.name: Google Business Profile
fields.description: Link to the shop on Google Maps. Used for the Reviews link.

fields.name: Service Area
fields.description: Where the service trucks go, in plain words. Shows on the On-Site Service page.

fields.name: After Hours Note
fields.description: Short note about after-hours calls. Shows on the Hours page.

fields.name: Time Zone
fields.description: Leave as America/Chicago. The Open Now line uses it.

tables.name: Hours
tables.description: Regular weekly hours, one row per day. Holidays go in Special Hours, not here.

fields.name: Day
fields.description: Monday through Sunday. Don't rename these.

fields.name: Order
fields.description: 1 for Monday through 7 for Sunday.

fields.name: Opens
fields.description: Like 7:30 AM. Leave blank if closed.

fields.name: Closes
fields.description: Like 5:30 PM. Leave blank if closed.

fields.name: Closed
fields.description: Tick for days the shop is closed all day.

fields.name: Note
fields.description: Optional short note shown next to the day.

tables.name: Special Hours
tables.description: Holiday closures, early closes and late opens. Each row shows in the red bar at the top of the website starting Show From Days before the date, and disappears by itself after. Also update holiday hours in the Google Business Profile app.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: What it is, like Thanksgiving or Christmas Eve.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: The day it applies.

fields.name: End Date
fields.description: Only for closures that run several days. Leave blank for one day.

fields.name: Type
fields.description: Closed all day, closing early, opening late, or different hours.

fields.name: Opens
fields.description: Only for Opening Late or Special Hours. Like 10:00 AM.

fields.name: Closes
fields.description: Only for Closing Early or Special Hours. Like 3:00 PM.

fields.name: Show From Days
fields.description: How many days ahead the banner starts showing. Blank means 14.

fields.name: Message
fields.description: Optional. Replaces the banner wording if you want to say it your own way.

fields.name: Show
fields.description: Tick to put it on the website. Untick to hide it.

tables.name: Coupons
tables.description: Specials and coupons. Featured ones show in the strip at the top of the home page; all of them show on the Specials page. Expired coupons hide themselves on the website the day after Expires.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Short name for your own use, like Alignment $20 off Nov 2026.

fields.name: Offer Type
fields.description: Picks how the big number reads: $20 OFF, 10% OFF, $49.95, FREE, or $100 REBATE (for manufacturer rebates).

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: The number only. 20 for $20 off, 10 for 10% off, 49.95 for a special price. Blank for Free.

fields.name: Applies To
fields.description: What the deal is on, like 4-wheel alignment. This is the coupon's headline.

fields.name: Details
fields.description: One short line under the headline, like Cars and pickups.

fields.name: Fine Print
fields.description: Limits, like One coupon per visit.

fields.name: Starts
fields.description: Optional. The coupon stays hidden until this date.

fields.name: Expires
fields.description: Last day it's good. Shows as Valid through.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: Coupon: a printable coupon, listed under Coupons. Special: something to ask about, like a manufacturer rebate, listed under Specials and rebates with no Print button. Blank means Coupon, except Rebates, which count as Specials.

fields.name: Featured
fields.description: Tick to show it in the home page specials strip. Up to 3 show there.

fields.name: Order
fields.description: Lower numbers show first. Use 10, 20, 30 to leave room.

fields.name: Show
fields.description: Tick to put it on the website. Untick to take it down early.

tables.name: Services
tables.description: One row per service. Each shown row gets its own page at fargotire.com/services/<Slug>/.

fields.name: Slug
fields.description: End of the page address, lowercase words joined by hyphens. Don't change it once the page is live, or old links break.

fields.name: Summary
fields.description: One or two sentences. Shows on the Services page and in Google results if Search Description is blank.

fields.name: Body
fields.description: The full page text. Bold, headings, lists and links carry through.

fields.name: Photo
fields.description: One or two photos for the top of the page. Landscape works best. Two show side by side, in this order.

fields.name: Photo Alt
fields.description: What the photo shows, in plain words, under 125 characters. For two photos, describe each in the same order with | between them.

fields.name: Search Title
fields.description: Title Google shows. Under 60 characters. Blank uses Name.

fields.name: Search Description
fields.description: Description Google shows. Under 160 characters. Blank uses Summary.

tables.name: Who We Serve
tables.description: The four photo tiles on the home page (cars, semis, farm, on-site).

fields.name: Link
fields.description: Where the tile goes, like /services/farm-tires/.

tables.name: Why Us
tables.description: The Fargo Tire Service Difference section on the home page.

tables.name: Brands
tables.description: Tire brands in the logo grid. Use the logo files the brand's dealer program provides.

fields.name: Logo
fields.description: One logo file, SVG or PNG with a transparent background.

fields.name: Link
fields.description: Optional link to the brand's site.

tables.name: Blog Posts
tables.description: Posts for the blog at fargotire.com/blog/. Edit here, then click Update website. Bold, headings, lists and links in Text carry through to the site.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: The post title shown on the page and in the blog list.

fields.name: Address
fields.description: End of the page address: fargotire.com/blog/<Address>/. Lowercase words joined by hyphens. Don't change it on a published post.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: Publish date shown on the post. Newest posts list first.

fields.name: Show
fields.description: Ticked: on the website. Unticked: hidden, and its address forwards to the blog.

fields.name: Cover Photo
fields.description: One picture. It leads the post, shows on the blog list, and is the picture when the post is shared.

fields.name: Summary
fields.description: Two or three sentences shown under the title in the blog list. Blank uses the start of Text.

fields.name: Search Title
fields.description: The title Google shows. Under 60 characters. Blank uses Title.

fields.name: Search Description
fields.description: The description Google shows. Under 160 characters.

fields.name: Text
fields.description: The body of the post.

tables.name: FAQ
tables.description: Questions and answers for the FAQ page. Edit here, then click Update website.

fields.name: Answer
fields.description: Bold, lists and links carry through to the site.

fields.name: Order
fields.description: Position on the page, lowest first. Use gaps (10, 20, 30).

tables.name: Site Text
tables.description: Headlines and short text blocks on the website, one row each. Edit Text, then click Update website. Don't rename rows: the site finds each one by its Name.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Where the text shows. The site looks rows up by this name, so leave it as is.

fields.name: Text
fields.description: The words on the site. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

tables.name: Site Images
tables.description: Pictures used on fixed parts of the site (tire man, home page photo, About photo, sharing image), one row each. Replace a picture here, then click Update website. Don't rename rows.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Where the picture shows. The site looks rows up by this name, so leave it as is.

fields.name: Image
fields.description: One picture.

fields.name: Alt Text
fields.description: What the picture shows, for screen readers and search. Under 125 characters.

tables.name: Leads
tables.description: Quote requests and questions from the website form land here, and an email goes to Form Notice Email. Update Status as you work them.

fields.name: Coupon
fields.description: Filled when someone used Request this special on a coupon.

fields.name: Page
fields.description: The page the form was sent from.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Where the request stands. Drag cards between these on the Quote Requests interface.
